Bihar MLC Elections: NDA Meeting Amidst Uncertainty

Ahead of the Bihar Legislative Council elections, the NDA coalition held meetings to finalize strategies, with attention focused on four MLAs, including Anant Singh. The discussions aimed to resolve internal differences and present a united front, with reports suggesting apprehension about political strategist Prashant Kishor's influence.
